products.name: Kira Systems
products.note: Contract analysis AI; legal document review; attorney-client privilege risk; confidential data

profile_text.body:
Litera is a legal technology company whose platform is used by more than 1 million legal professionals daily and, by its own account, by 99% of the Am Law 100 and 74% of the Fortune 100. The company describes itself as having built accuracy over 30 years and positions its offering as a unified platform intended to support the full range of legal work, from matter scoping to drafting, integrated directly into Microsoft 365 and a modern desktop client called Litera for Windows.

The company's AI work centers on what it calls a Legal AI ecosystem, anchored by Lito, an AI agent it describes as award-winning, which operates inside Microsoft Word and across its broader platform. Litera also holds Kira Systems, a contract analysis AI product focused on legal document review, attorney-client privilege risk, and handling of confidential data. The company recently announced capabilities connecting contract drafting and negotiation in a single workflow and has signaled a broader relaunch positioning itself as a unified Legal AI provider running on one agent and one dataset.

The site's held facts confirm Litera has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org with Kira Systems listed under the Finance and Legal AI category. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are noted in the available data.
